rationale.hitl-workflow: Defines tiered human control surfaces, reviews, and bounds for AI tasks.
rationale.framework: Integrates hybrid team AI validation protocols directly into Agile workflows.
rationale.design-only: Specifies the HAIF protocol and tiers but lacks empirical field evaluation.
rationale.assistive: Tier 1 models AI supporting human execution at the assistive level.
rationale.agentic: Tiers 2-4 model AI producing complete artifacts requiring human gating.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Mandates human-only cycles to actively maintain competence and prevent skill atrophy.
rationale.risk-quality: Provides specific validation protocols and checklists for verifying output correctness.
